Long, flowing charcoal black hair with straight-cut bangs and two long strands framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped amber orange eyes with a confident expression. Appears to be a late teenager with a mature, poised face. Slender, athletic build. A short, sleeveless navy blue dress with white accents and a large red bow on the lower back. Includes a white officer's cap with a black brim and black thigh-high stockings.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
